metadata.title: Mandara pottery: paper-derived qualitative teaching layer
metadata.status: Derived from statements in the paper; not a substitute for the official row-level dataset
metadata.paper_title: Mixture model of pottery distributions from Lake Chad Basin archaeological sites reveals ancient segregation patterns
metadata.authors: John D. O’Brien, Kathryn Lin, Scott MacEachern
metadata.license_statement: The paper states that scripts and cleaned data are freely available under a Creative Commons license. The exact CC variant is not specified in the current DataCite record.

metadata.limitations: The matrix below encodes dominant/smaller cultural-period memberships reported in the paper text. It is qualitative (0, 0.35, 1), not raw counts or posterior probabilities. Upload the official XLS/XLSX in the app for row-level exploration.
